about_short_description.short_description: CoLoop offers an AI platform for qualitative research analysis, enabling faster transcription, analysis, and summarization of data.

product.name: CoLoop AI Platform
product.description: An AI-powered platform for qualitative research analysis that automates transcription, translation, coding, and thematic analysis of qualitative data.

product.name: Analysis Grids
product.description: A tool within CoLoop that generates customizable grids to organize and analyze qualitative data by participant, segment, or group.

product.name: Clip Creation Tool
product.description: A feature that enables users to select and extract audio or video snippets from transcripts for use in presentations or editing.

product.name: AI Chat Interface
product.description: An interactive chat feature that answers questions about uploaded qualitative research files, segments, and tasks with full source transparency.

product.name: Team Collaboration Features
product.description: Functionality that allows multiple users to access, manage, and collaborate on qualitative research projects in real time within CoLoop.

product.name: Integration with Incling
product.description: A data integration feature that allows seamless export of qualitative data collected via Incling into CoLoop for AI-driven analysis.
